The application is built, verified, and now running for your review. We're at **Phase 4 (Acceptance)**.

## ✅ Verification report (plain language)

I tested the real app against every behaviour we approved together, at two levels — and **all tests pass**:

- **Behaviour tests (11) — one per approved flow**, driving the actual app in a real browser exactly as you would:
  - Save a link → details fill in automatically, newest on top
  - A malformed address is refused; an unreadable page is kept with a warning; a duplicate points you to the one you already have
  - Add tags (with suggestions / create-new) and a note by editing
  - Search across title, address, description, tags, and notes — with highlighting — and browse by tag, combined
  - Mark to-read/finished and switch focused tabs
  - Archive (hidden from everyday lists) and restore
  - Edit any field including the web address (re-checked)
  - Permanent delete behind a confirmation that's clearly distinct from archiving
  - The friendly empty state for a brand-new start
- **Internal quality tests (32 total)** covering validation, page-detail reading with graceful fallback, persistence, and all API operations.

I also confirmed your **bookmarks persist between sessions** (they're still there after a restart), matching your "one place" goal.

## 🔗 Open your app

**http://maker:4000** — it starts empty (the welcome state), ready for you to save your first link.

A couple of honest notes:
- It's a **personal, single-user** app with no login, exactly as scoped.
- Reading a page's details needs internet access to that page; when a page can't be reached, the link is still saved with the warning-and-edit path we agreed on.

Nothing was deferred to a later cycle — every request you raised during our exploration was folded into this build.

---

Please take it for a spin. **Do you accept this software as meeting the behaviour we approved, and agree to complete this cycle?** If anything doesn't behave the way we settled on, tell me specifically and I'll treat it as a fix within this cycle.
